question: Could you assess the relationship between the poverty rates from the previous year's census data and the percentage of births without maternal morbidity for the years 2016 to 2018? Use only data for births where no maternal morbidity was reported and for each year, use the 5-year census data from the year before to compute the Pearson correlation coefficient
sql:
WITH data_2016 AS (
  SELECT 
    n.County_of_Residence_FIPS,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(
      SUM(CASE WHEN n.Maternal_Morbidity_YN = 1 THEN n.Births ELSE 0 END),
      SUM(n.Births)
    ) as pct_no_morbidity,
    MIN(SAFE_DIVIDE(c.poverty, c.pop_determined_poverty_status)) as poverty_rate
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.sdoh_cdc_wonder_natality.county_natality_by_maternal_morbidity` n
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2015_5yr` c 
    ON n.County_of_Residence_FIPS = c.geo_id
  WHERE n.Year = '2016-01-01' 
    AND n.Maternal_Morbidity_YN IN (0, 1)
    AND c.pop_determined_poverty_status > 0
  GROUP BY n.County_of_Residence_FIPS
),
data_2017 AS (
  SELECT 
    n.County_of_Residence_FIPS,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(
      SUM(CASE WHEN n.Maternal_Morbidity_YN = 1 THEN n.Births ELSE 0 END),
      SUM(n.Births)
    ) as pct_no_morbidity,
    MIN(SAFE_DIVIDE(c.poverty, c.pop_determined_poverty_status)) as poverty_rate
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.sdoh_cdc_wonder_natality.county_natality_by_maternal_morbidity` n
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2016_5yr` c 
    ON n.County_of_Residence_FIPS = c.geo_id
  WHERE n.Year = '2017-01-01' 
    AND n.Maternal_Morbidity_YN IN (0, 1)
    AND c.pop_determined_poverty_status > 0
  GROUP BY n.County_of_Residence_FIPS
),
data_2018 AS (
  SELECT 
    n.County_of_Residence_FIPS,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(
      SUM(CASE WHEN n.Maternal_Morbidity_YN = 1 THEN n.Births ELSE 0 END),
      SUM(n.Births)
    ) as pct_no_morbidity,
    MIN(SAFE_DIVIDE(c.poverty, c.pop_determined_poverty_status)) as poverty_rate
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.sdoh_cdc_wonder_natality.county_natality_by_maternal_morbidity` n
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2017_5yr` c 
    ON n.County_of_Residence_FIPS = c.geo_id
  WHERE n.Year = '2018-01-01' 
    AND n.Maternal_Morbidity_YN IN (0, 1)
    AND c.pop_determined_poverty_status > 0
  GROUP BY n.County_of_Residence_FIPS
),
corr_2016 AS (
  SELECT 
    2016 as year,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(
      (COUNT(*) * SUM(poverty_rate * pct_no_morbidity) - SUM(poverty_rate) * SUM(pct_no_morbidity)),
      SQRT((COUNT(*) * SUM(poverty_rate * poverty_rate) - SUM(poverty_rate) * SUM(poverty_rate)) * 
           (COUNT(*) * SUM(pct_no_morbidity * pct_no_morbidity) - SUM(pct_no_morbidity) * SUM(pct_no_morbidity)))
    ) as pearson_r
  FROM data_2016
),
corr_2017 AS (
  SELECT 
    2017 as year,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(
      (COUNT(*) * SUM(poverty_rate * pct_no_morbidity) - SUM(poverty_rate) * SUM(pct_no_morbidity)),
      SQRT((COUNT(*) * SUM(poverty_rate * poverty_rate) - SUM(poverty_rate) * SUM(poverty_rate)) * 
           (COUNT(*) * SUM(pct_no_morbidity * pct_no_morbidity) - SUM(pct_no_morbidity) * SUM(pct_no_morbidity)))
    ) as pearson_r
  FROM data_2017
),
corr_2018 AS (
  SELECT 
    2018 as year,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(
      (COUNT(*) * SUM(poverty_rate * pct_no_morbidity) - SUM(poverty_rate) * SUM(pct_no_morbidity)),
      SQRT((COUNT(*) * SUM(poverty_rate * poverty_rate) - SUM(poverty_rate) * SUM(poverty_rate)) * 
           (COUNT(*) * SUM(pct_no_morbidity * pct_no_morbidity) - SUM(pct_no_morbidity) * SUM(pct_no_morbidity)))
    ) as pearson_r
  FROM data_2018
)
SELECT * FROM corr_2016
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM corr_2017
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM corr_2018
ORDER BY year
